Appendix table 5. Adults under community supervision, by jurisdiction, 2021

column12: Number under community supervision per 100,000 adult U.S. residents, December 31, 2021/c

column1: Note: Counts are rounded to the nearest 100. Details may not sum to totals due to rounding. Due to nonresponse or incomplete data, the community supervision population for some jurisdictions on December 31, 2021 does not equal the population on January 1, 2021 plus entries, minus exits.
a/Excludes adults on parole who were also on probation: 25,414 on January 1, 2021 and 21,275 on December 31, 2021. See Methodology.
b/Imputed counts differ from reported counts in jurisdictions where data were not available.

c/Rates are based on community supervision counts as of December 31 of the reporting year and calculated using U.S. Census Bureau estimates of U.S. residents age 18 or older for January 1 of the following year in each jurisdiction.
d/January 1 and December 31 probation counts are estimates of individuals.
Source: Bureau of Justice Statistics, Annual Probation Survey and Annual Parole Survey, 2021; and U.S. Census Bureau, National Intercensal Estimates, 2022.
